correctness.rationale: The domain is the simplex minus a homothetic small simplex. Homogeneous moment scaling gives the exact retained volume, mean and two raw quadratic moments. Permutation symmetry yields covariance eigenvalues B (twice) and 4B−3m² (once). Their determinant divided by volume squared factors as claimed; its derivative is the displayed strictly negative factored rational expression for 0<t<1. Both endpoints and the affine triangular-prism limit check. Independently triangulating into three tetrahedra and integrating moments in exact rationals passed 151 checks. All parameters and degeneracy restrictions are explicit; finite tests are not claimed to prove the continuum.

value.rationale: The isotropic constant is a basic affine-geometric invariant; clipping one vertex of a tetrahedron is the simplest asymmetric tetrahedral perturbation and creates a natural complete family connecting the simplex to the prism. Exact strict monotonicity, sharp normalized endpoint ratio, cubic small-cut response and quadratic thin-limit response classify this entire motivated family. This is not presented as a universal inequality or a major theorem.
